approved_statement:
I authorize one ZERO.5 S1 scale-control run on AWS (c6i.4xlarge, us-east-1) under the frozen contract.

Authorization covers: one on-demand c6i.4xlarge instance up to 43,200 seconds, a hard $8.20 cost ceiling enforced in user-data, automatic termination, 30-second state sync to S3, a fresh 24,323,264-parameter model (5.01x baseline) trained through the two-stage matched recipe (Atlas pretrain, C4.3 grouped packs), and evaluation on the frozen C4.2 span-choice instruments.

This is a capacity control, not an architecture claim. No promotion, replication, checkpoint publication, corpus publication, or sealed-test access.
